Aisha (People Ops): Heads-up: we're rolling out a harmonized vacation accrual table in the handbook to reduce localized variance. Draft is live in Confluence — please skim. Main ask: managers must confirm any local deviations by uploading an exemptions CSV by May 5. Link + template below. :spiral_calendar:
Aisha (People Ops): Why - we've seen inconsistent accruals for new hires across regions causing payroll reconciliation work. This will standardize BASE accrual and document exceptions centrally.
Marco (HR Ops): Quick link to the draft: https://confluence.company/handbook/vacation-harmonize. Changes are limited to sections 4.2-4.5.
Lena (Eng Mgr): For part-timers and contractors — do they get treated under the new table or remain under existing local contracts?
Marco (HR Ops): Contractors stay under contractor policy. Part-time/PRN employees follow local labor law; if that means a different accrual, include them in the exemptions CSV and indicate the legal basis.
Devon (Recruiting): Is this retroactive for people hired in the last 30 days? We had a candidate start with special accrual terms last week.
Aisha (People Ops): Not retroactive to signed offers. If someone's contract explicitly states a different accrual, mark them as "contract-locked" in the CSV and attach the offer reference in the Upload notes.
Aisha (People Ops): Upload process: managers or their HR partners submit one CSV per team via Secure HR Upload: https://upload.company/hr-exemptions (internal SSO). Use the template exactly. Filename format: teamname_exemptions_YYYYMMDD.csv
Aisha (People Ops): CSV template (required headers):
```csv
employee_id,legal_name,role,country,exemption_reason,exemption_start,exemption_end,notes
12345,Jane Doe,PM,UK,contract-locked,2024-04-01,2025-04-01,Offer#4567
```
Lena (Eng Mgr): Thanks. Will do bulk for my org. Do we need manager signatures?
Marco (HR Ops): No physical signature. Upload logs will record Uploader and timestamp. HR will follow up for missing documentation.
Aisha (People Ops): Also - short mandatory 15-min compliance brief for people managers covering the new table and how to use the CSV uploader. Sessions: May 2 / May 4 / May 6 at 09:00 PT. Recording will be posted. Completion is tracked in the Compliance Training dashboard.
Devon (Recruiting): If a new hire's offer hasn't been finalized by May 5, is it ok to leave them off the CSV and update later?
Aisha (People Ops): Yes, update later but try to complete updates within two pay cycles. Flag "pending-offer" in notes so payroll knows.
hr-bot: Reminder: Vacation accrual harmonization confirmations due by 2245556900 (May 5). Upload: https://upload.company/hr-exemptions
hr-bot: Tools checklist: 1) CSV uploaded; 2) supporting docs attached if contract-locked; 3) manager completed 15-min brief or recorded watch logged.
Lena (Eng Mgr): Uploaded my CSV for ENG-PLATFORM. Included two part-time folks with legal notes. :white_check_mark:
Marco (HR Ops): Got it Lena, we'll validate tomorrow and ping if anything's missing. Thanks.
Aisha (People Ops): Appreciate the fast turnarounds. If your org spans multiple countries and you want HR help preparing the CSV, book a 15-min slot here: https://cal.company/hr-help. :pray:
